a: JSON is strict and ubiquitous; YAML is friendlier for config but easier to footgun.
TOML is a readable config format used by pyproject.toml and many tools.
KEY=value lines; no secrets in git.
Commas inside quotes, encodings, and newlines break naive split(',').
A UTF-8 BOM at file start can break parsers — strip it if needed.
Newline-delimited JSON (JSONL) is one object per line for streaming datasets.
Protocol Buffers are compact typed binary messages with schemas.
Avro is row-oriented; Parquet is columnar for analytics.
MIME types label payload format, e.g. application/json.
Base64 encodes binary as text; it is encoding, not encryption.
